techcrunch.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
techcrunch.summary: Recursive’s emphasis on self-improving AI systems means much of the budget that would traditionally go toward headcount and operations is put straight into compute, as the company seeks to automate its own product development process.

techcrunch.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
techcrunch.summary: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.
